svg.title: NextView architecture
svg.desc: Browser client, AWS API Gateway and Lambda container running the OpenCV 5 perceive-decide-act loop with human approval gates, S3, CloudWatch and ECR, and the local MCP server, LLM driver and benchmark harness.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One request = one perceive → decide → act step. The same tool functions serve the AWS endpoint, the benchmark and the local MCP server.
